title: Pillow through 13.1.0 contains an integer overflow in the ImageMath integer divide and modulo operators (DIV_I and…
description: Pillow versions through 13.1.0 have an integer overflow vulnerability in the ImageMath integer divide and modulo operators (DIV_I and MOD_I). This flaw occurs because these operators only guard against a zero divisor, but dividing INT32_MIN by -1 triggers a hardware divide exception. An attacker can exploit this by supplying a crafted TIFF image that decodes to a mode I image containing INT32_MIN, causing applications performing such operations to crash.
